title: Called back from leave through a blizzard before Base 2 duty

tellings.quote: And it was a blizzard. There was a blizzard the entire way home.

plain: Sometime between 1990 and 1993, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman was called back from leave and drove home to base, he says, through "a blizzard the entire way". It came just before his duty at a posting he calls Base 2. Sherman tells it himself as part of his account of work he says the NSA gave him, which he describes as communicating with aliens.
